item.title: Checking In On Somnium Space, The Blockchain-Based PC Social VR Platform
item.description: We took a fresh look at Somnium Space, the blockchain-based PC social VR platform that continues to receive impressive feature updates.

item.title: Meta Funds University Teams To Explore Wider Applications Of sEMG Wristband Input
item.description: Meta’s latest research grants back university projects exploring speech, accessibility, training, privacy, and user agency in wrist-based sEMG control.

item.title: Attending Balenciaga’s Summer 26 Show in Apple Vision Pro
item.description: You can step onto the runway and experience Pier Paolo Piccioli’s debut with the Summer 26 show in Balenciaga's Apple Vision Pro app.

item.title: Meta's Lawyers Shut Down The Primary Source Of Pirated Quest Games
item.description: Meta's lawyers successfully shut down VRPirates, which was by far the largest and most prominent source of pirated Quest VR games.

item.title: Among Us 3D: VR Definitive Edition Delayed To April
item.description: Among Us 3D: VR - The Definitive Edition, Schell Games' parting gift to the community, has been delayed to April.

item.title: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands Review - A Meditative VR Escape
item.description: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands delivers a serene VR puzzle experience, combining clever 3D challenges, soothing atmosphere, and a charming companion.

item.title: Darts VR2: Bullseye Targets An April Release Date
item.description: Darts VR2: Bulleye, the sequel to the 2017 PC VR original, aims for an April release on Quest, PlayStation VR2, and PC VR.

item.title: Chaotic Free-To-Play VR Shooter Frenzies Shuts Down In April
item.description: Chaotic free-to-play multiplayer VR shooter Frenzies will shut down next month, following the closure of its development studio.

item.title: visionOS 27 Will Likely Be Unveiled On June 8
item.description: Apple's WWDC 2026 is set to take place from June 8, and visionOS 27 will likely be announced during it.

item.title: Clear XR Brings Apple Vision Pro's Foveated Streaming To OpenXR PC VR Games
item.description: Clear XR, available on TestFlight, lets Nvidia RTX 40 and 50 series owners use Apple Vision Pro's foveated streaming feature for OpenXR PC VR games.
